# Door Jamb Hanger (Stepped & Flared Snap-Fit C-Clamp)

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model of a stepped and flared snap-fit C-clamp hanger designed to attach to a door jamb. It features a saddle to hold a horizontal rod (such as a 1/2" PVC pipe), making it perfect for temporary hanging or mounting applications in a doorway.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
